## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Shèngsīwéi Fàntiān suǒwèn jīng* (T587) is Bodhiruci I's 菩提流支 ([菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF)) six-fascicle Northern Wèi translation of the *Brahma-viśeṣa-cintī-paripṛcchā* / *Viśeṣacintā-brahma-paripṛcchā*. *Shèngsīwéi* 勝思惟 ("Excellent Thought") is yet another rendering of *Viśeṣacintin*, paralleling Dharmarakṣa's *Chíxīn* in [KR6i0217](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0217) and Kumārajīva's *Sīyì* in [KR6i0218](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0218).

**Abstract**

The third and most expansive Chinese rendering of the *Brahma-viśeṣa-cintī-paripṛcchā*, datable to Bodhiruci I's translation activity at Luòyáng (508–535 CE) under the Northern Wèi. It is the longest of the three Chinese versions and draws on a fuller Indic recension. Together with [KR6i0217](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0217) and [KR6i0218](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0218), it forms the three-translation cycle of one of the most important Madhyamaka-leaning Mahāyāna sūtras.
